usedFor: AgencyAnalytics is where client reporting lives; HubSpot is where you manage the relationship. A “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics can run “Create Deal” so a new account gets a deal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A client added to reporting is a confirmed account, so a deal records it for handover or upsell.

watchOut: Both triggers are polling, so deals follow the next check. “New User” can fire many times for one client, and “Update Deal” needs the deal ID.
